fact: The 11th Somalia Education Statistics Yearbook 2023-2024 compiles annual school-level returns submitted through the Ministry of Education's online EMIS (school records, one source, with Federal Member State validation) and compares them with 2022/2023, the previous yearbook edition; population denominators come from the 2014 Population Estimation Survey.
title: Annual Education statistics yearbook (11th Somalia Education Statistics Yearbook 2023-2024)
publisher: Ministry of Education, Culture and Higher Education
